correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed both graph adjacencies from RESULT.md and verify.py, confirmed degree 6 and common-neighbor count 2, all 2^16 vertex masks via independent connected-component cyclomatic test. Exact Sh faces by size 0..7: (1,16,120,528,1440,2352,1952,512); rook: (1,16,120,528,1392,2160,1728,576); no larger forests. Fresh greedy vertex-toggle acyclic Morse DAG has 3370/3204 pairs, respective critical 4-,5-,6-cell counts (2,143,36)/(4,37,72). Independent signed integral Morse differential computation gives ∂6=0, ∂5 ranks 2/4 with unit maximal minors as in source; these kill degree-4 cells primitively. Homotopy cancellation and π5(wedge S5)=Z^k then yield Sh ∨141 S5 ∨36 S6 and rook ∨33 S5 ∨72 S6, not merely rational Betti equality.
